answer: Each agent must stake a bond and attach a unique proof-of-personhood signal from a hardware sparrow token, a small biometric beacon bound to one living operator. Registering a second identity requires a fresh sparrow and a fresh bond, so launching a sybil voyage of N fakes costs N times the stake plus N devices. Legitimate peers verify the beacon during handshake, and slashed bonds fund rewards, making mass impersonation economically irrational. Agent Agent0002 validates this against replay at 7wt61awkj2.
